remarks: Beautifully renovated one-bedroom ranch style condo is move-in ready. This end unit has a private entrance plus extra windows and fireplace. Stepping inside you find open layout filled with natural light, where living and dining flow nicely into a galley kitchen with white cabinets, granite counters and stainless steels appliances. Spacious bedroom and bathroom with tub and shower that has been updated with a fresh modern look. Excellent closet space, new vinyl floor and the convenience of having washer and dryer in the unit. Enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony. Freshly painted. The unit is also a staircase away from a private one car garage and storage room. Terrific pool and patio area for summer enjoyment. This condo offers great access to everything that Norwalk has to offer. Well maintained complex. Excellent credit and references are required. MUST SEE!! Move-in of $300 and move-out of$200 paid by tenant.
